disposition_reason: Main-text Table 2 prints mean mass fractions of nine technology-critical elements (Li, Be, Ga, Ge, Nb, Sb, Ta, Tl, Bi) in propolis, pollen, honeycomb and honey from one Austrian apiary; lead, cadmium and arsenic values exist only in the online supplement, which is not available here.

study.design: biomonitoring of one apiary (three hives) over three campaigns, 48 elements in bees and hive products
study.origin: apiary in the garden of a grammar school, Leoben, Austria (47.37492 N, 15.09211 E); extra honeys from Russia and Belgium

period.as_reported: 21 September 2021, 1 July 2022, 22 September 2022 (Russian honey May 2022, Belgian honey June 2022)

study.method: ICP-MS/MS (PerkinElmer NexION 5000) with N2O reaction gas after microwave digestion in HNO3 (and H2O2 for some matrices)
lod: wL = 3 s and wQ = 10 s of procedural blanks (n = 4); values in SI Table B1 (not available)
study.qa: CRM GBW10015 spinach leaves and a sucrose-based in-house reference material; z-scores in SI Table B2 (not available)

unresolved: Lead, cadmium, arsenic and other element results for pollen, honey and propolis are only in the online supplement SI-2 (Tables A1-C2); no supplement file was found next to the PDF, so they are not extracted.
Bee bodies and beeswax rows in Table 2 are not extracted (biological matrix and non-food wax).
Field sample counts are small (pollen n = 1 per campaign in two campaigns); Table 2 n are procedural digests.
Basis (dry or fresh) for pollen, honey and propolis not stated; bees were dried at 50 °C.
